config.label: The vault account, for example acme
config.description: The vault account, for example acme.vaults.probarion.testnet. A name ending in .near is on mainnet, one ending in .testnet on testnet

config.label: mainnet or testnet
config.description: mainnet or testnet. Needed only when the vault id ends in neither .near nor .testnet; when set, the vault id's ending must agree with it

config.label: Absolute path of the keys file that probarion-mcp init wrote, which must exist
config.description: Absolute path of the keys file that probarion-mcp init wrote, which must exist. Default ~/.probarion/<vault>/keys.json, used when it exists. With no keys the server is read-only

config.label: The agent key's secret (ed25519:
config.description: The agent key's secret (ed25519:...), the vault's key that can only call spend, in place of a keys file. Set it with PROBARION_LEDGER_KEY, or neither

config.label: The ledger key's secret (ed25519:
config.description: The ledger key's secret (ed25519:...), the vault's key that can only call anchor, in place of a keys file. Set it with PROBARION_AGENT_KEY, or neither

config.label: Comma-separated https:// NEAR RPC URLs in failover order, with no user name or password (http:// only for a node on this machine)
config.description: Comma-separated https:// NEAR RPC URLs in failover order, with no user name or password (http:// only for a node on this machine). Default: the public RPCs @probarion/core lists for the network

config.label: Comma-separated archival RPC URLs that verify reads old transactions from, with the same rules as NEAR_RPC_URLS
config.description: Comma-separated archival RPC URLs that verify reads old transactions from, with the same rules as NEAR_RPC_URLS. Default: FastNEAR's archival node

config.label: Absolute path of the ledger file: a relative one is taken from the folder the client starts the server in
config.description: Absolute path of the ledger file: a relative one is taken from the folder the client starts the server in. Default ~/.probarion/<vault>/ledger.jsonl
